{{samename|{{tc|Team Flare}} scientist|Mable}} [[File:Mabel.png|thumb|250px|Mabel]] '''Mabel''' (Japanese: '''メープル''' ''Maple'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY034|The Bonds of Mega Evolution!]]''. She is a {{pkmn|Trainer}} who has an understanding of [[Mega Evolution]]. Mabel lives on [[Pomace Mountain]] in an assemblage of tree houses and mainly spends her time picking and arranging flowers. She moves around in a hovercar so she can pick up the flowers she finds easier. {{an|Korrina}} was sent to Mabel by her grandfather [[Gurkinn]], who had trained under Mabel when he was younger. Gurkinn hoped Mabel would teach Korrina to understand Mega Evolution better after her {{TP|Korrina|Lucario}} had gone berserk twice after Mega Evolving. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived at Pomace Mountain, Mabel immediately proposed that Korrina demonstrate her battle prowess. During the match, Lucario once again went berserk, and Mabel ended the match with a gust of {{m|Fairy Wind}}. After this, Korrina desperately asked for Mabel's help. Mabel took Korrina and the group inside her house, and she assigned them to arrange flowers so she could analyze the [[friendship]] between the Trainers and their Pokémon. Over the next few days, Mabel had Korrina and the group repeat the same activity, with Korrina becoming increasingly skeptical of Mabel's training methods. One night, Mabel eventually revealed her secret method, admitting that Korrina and Lucario shared one heart but had two different viewpoints, which led to Lucario's outbursts while Mega Evolved. Later, {{TRT}} arrived, stealing {{AP|Pikachu}} and Mabel's Mawile. Korrina Mega Evolved her Lucario to try to save them, but Mega Lucario went berserk once more. Using Mabel's lessons, Korrina stopped Mega Lucario. They were finally able to bond perfectly and broke Mega Lucario's anger. Now completely in sync with Korrina, Mega Lucario saved Pikachu and Mawile, and blasted Team Rocket off with its newly learned {{m|Aura Sphere}}. The next day, Korrina thanked Mabel for her teachings, and Mabel gave her one last advice; to continue trying to reach new heights, even though she and Mega Lucario had mastered Mega Evolution now. She bade Korrina and the others farewell. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mabel |pkmn=Mawile |mega=yes |type1=Steel |type2=Fairy |img=Mabel Mawile.png |cap=Mabel's Mawile |img2=Mabel Mega Mawile.png |cap2=Mabel's Mega Mawile |epnum=XY034 |epname=The Bonds of Mega Evolution! |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc={{p|Mawile}} is Mabel's only known Pokémon. It was first seen welcoming {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} when they arrived at Mabel's home and was used in Mabel's battle against {{an|Korrina}}. It battled [[Korrina's Lucario]] and they both Mega Evolved. Due to Mega Lucario not listening and raging out of control, Mega Mawile was easily able to win. Later, Mawile was kidnapped by Team Rocket along with {{AP|Pikachu}}. However, they were freed by Korrina's Mega Lucario after it managed to control itself. Mawile Mega Evolved once more and, with the help of Mega Lucario and Pikachu, blasted Team Rocket off. Mawile's known moves are {{m|Iron Head}} and {{m|Fairy Wind}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{steel color}}|bordercolor={{fairy color light}} |ja=かないみか ''[[Mika Kanai]]'' |en=[[Erica Schroeder]] |fi=Sari Ann Moilanen |he=עדי בר לב ''Adi Bar Lev'' |es_eu=Marisa Marco |pl=Anna Apostolakis}}
